summary.text: Myriad Ghost Sword Dragon is Fang Yuan's immortal killer move. Countless black dragon-shaped soul beasts fly out, and each use expends four thousand soul path dao marks.

claims.text: Pursued into white heaven by Li Huang and Qing Ye, Fang Yuan activates this immortal killer move. It is a fusion of ancient sword dragon transformation, myriad self, yama child, emperor yama, and familiar face, and one of his greatest achievements in killer move modification a while back. A loud explosion follows. Countless black dragon-shaped soul beasts fly out, with silver-white claws, teeth, horns, and scales, emitting an eerie sword qi at all times. Some attack the pursuers. The rest fly aimlessly in a chaotic manner. When the ghost dragons self-detonate they have incredible might: the explosive force of the soul beast plus rampaging sword qi. After tens of self-detonations, Li Huang’s verdant sun flame cloak flickers and weakens. Qing Ye is forced onto the defensive. The move has the same weakness and price as Wu Yong’s unlimited wind: it expends the Gu Immortal’s dao marks permanently. Unlimited wind uses ten thousand dao marks each time; this move uses four thousand soul path dao marks per use. Fang Yuan uses that opening to escape into black-white overturning clouds.

Fang Yuan created the move near the time of the Central Continent Refinement Path Convention. Without myriad self Immortal Gu, he would need too many Gu worms to activate it, the time taken would be too long, and there would be no use for it in battle.
